candidates.name: Colorado Specialties, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Contact page: 'we do installation of FRP, Toilet and Bathroom Accessories, Toilet Partitions, Wall Protection systems'. Homepage lists partition brands and commercial projects (Denver International Airport, Mile High Stadium, Children's Hospital Denver).
red_flags: Stocking distributor and manufacturers' rep for ASI, Scranton, Bradley, Metpar and Bobrick: high buy-around risk, and it may compete with us on partitions
candidates.reason: Golden-based Division 10 distributor and installer that says outright it installs toilet partitions across Colorado and Wyoming, with major commercial projects in Denver. It also sells the same brands we do.

license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. A companyName query for 'Colorado Specialties' on the official search's public API (den.denvergov.org/api/contractor-license-search/search/) returned 0 rows. Confirm by hand on the Denver search page or the Accela licensed-contractor search before listing. The business is based in Golden. A Denver license is needed only to pull permits inside Denver; the Denver page doesn't say whether partition installation needs a permit.
